notes: Rule 11: the scene carries a second saying («فكان رسول الله يرتفق عليهما») with its own transmitter, the kunya «أبا محمد» that Rabi'a names in the room; it is not written as a route here
«أباه» is bare: the father of Abd al-Rahman is a relation link
The editor's gloss «يريد القاسم بن محمد» is left out and is not used to name Abu Muhammad
Rabi'a ibn Ata is in the scene, not a link
